latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the docx-trackchanges-and-comments skill.
- Enables editing Word (.docx) files with support for track changes (insertions, deletions, redline edits) and comment (annotation) operations.
- Allows enabling/disabling revision mode, and adding/removing/viewing comments directly by editing relevant OOXML files.
- Includes detailed instructions for XML-level manipulation and manual document unpacking/repacking.
